events.title: Grave Orbit Demo – Full Act I Run, Streaming on the Store Page
events.summary: Grave Orbit is part of Steam Next Fest. We're streaming a complete run of the demo on this page: one Core, four chapters, from Outer Space to No Escape, with commentary generated from in-game events. The demo is free – install it, run the same four chapters, and see whether your base holds longer than this one.

events.title: Slick Gaming held the Core for an hour
events.summary: Slick Gaming played the Grave Orbit demo start to finish and recommended it to his players. One Core, waves from every direction, one hour!The demo is free. Grave Orbit is in Steam Next Fest from October 19.

events.title: Watch the Full Grave Orbit Demo with Live Commentary
events.summary: Want to see what the Grave Orbit demo holds before you play it?Here is the whole of Act I in one video. Four chapters at the edge of the Solar System: Outer Space, First Encounter, Blood Space and No Escape. Watch a lone Core grow from a single turret into a working defense, lose, rebuild in the Workshop, and push on into the next, harder chapter.Commentary in the video is generated live from in-game events and read by a synthetic voice.The demo is free to play now.

events.title: Grave Orbit Demo Is Now Live
events.summary: The Grave Orbit demo is now live on Steam.Fight through escalating enemy assaults, recover the wreckage they leave behind, and turn it into the production, upgrades and defenses your Core needs to survive what comes next.Each battle feeds the next expansion. What begins as a fragile defense gradually grows into a larger automated system that must keep producing, supplying and fighting under increasing pressure.Play the demo now and see how far you can push your defense.
